title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure & Site Reliability Engineer
description_raw: We are seeking a Senior Cloud Infrastructure & SRE to oversee cloud reliability, automated provisioning with Terraform, zero-downtime deployment pipelines, and global multi-region resilience. You will collaborate directly with security and development squads to guarantee 99.99% uptime for our AI candidate intelligence platform.

requirements.requirement_text: 5+ years managing AWS or GCP cloud infrastructure at scale
Proficiency in Terraform, Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), and GitOps
Deep expertise in Kubernetes cluster management, Helm charts, and Envoy networking
Experience configuring Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, and incident response runbooks
